## Pull request overview

This PR makes the Console’s `ObjectView` consume `ViewConfigPanel` draft changes immediately so the main view updates in real time, and upgrades the config panel’s Data section to edit columns/filters/sort inline using shared builder components.

**Changes:**
- Wire `ViewConfigPanel` draft updates into `ObjectView` (`onViewUpdate` + draft merge) so `showSearch`/`showFilters` (and other fields) react without clicking Save.
- Replace read-only “Columns / Filter / Sort” summary rows with inline editors (Checkbox list, `FilterBuilder`, `SortBuilder`).
- Extend `ViewConfigPanel` tests to cover live draft propagation and inline builder interactions.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 6 out of 6 changed files in this pull request and generated 5 comments.

<details>
<summary>Comments suppressed due to low confidence (1)</summary>

**apps/console/src/__tests__/ViewConfigPanel.test.tsx:91**
* The test fixtures use object-shaped filters (`{ field, operator, value }`), but real `listViews.filter` in this repo is typically spec-style arrays (e.g. `['type', '=', 'Customer']` or `[['status','!=','Done']]`). As a result, these tests won’t catch the current bridge incompatibility or operator mapping issues. Update the mocked `activeView.filter` to use the canonical array format and add assertions that the bridge renders the correct number of conditions and preserves operators/values when edited.
```
const mockActiveView = {
    id: 'all',
    label: 'All Records',
    type: 'grid',
    columns: ['name', 'stage', 'amount'],
    filter: [{ field: 'stage', operator: '=', value: 'active' }],
    sort: [{ field: 'name', order: 'asc' }],
};
```
</details>

`filterGroupValue` assumes `draft.filter` is an array of objects (`{field, operator, value}`), but in this repo view configs commonly use `@objectstack/spec-style` array filters (e.g. `['field', '=', value]`, `[['field','=',value]]`, or `['and', ...]`). With current code, a triplet like `['type','=', 'Customer']` will be treated as 3 conditions and rendered/edited incorrectly, and saving will rewrite the filter into a different shape. Please implement a robust bridge that detects and converts the supported array formats into `FilterGroup` (including logic 'and'/'or' where possible), and converts back to the canonical filter format expected by `@object-ui/plugin-view` / `dataSource.find`.

`FilterBuilder` expects operator values like `equals`, `notEquals`, etc. Passing through `f.operator` (which is often `'='`/`'!='` in spec-style filters) will result in an operator that doesn't match any option in the builder UI. The filter bridge should map between spec operators (`=`, `!=`, `in`, etc.) and `FilterBuilder` operator IDs in both directions to avoid rendering blank operators and to prevent saving incompatible values.

`Checkbox` (Radix) `onCheckedChange` provides `CheckedState` (`boolean | 'indeterminate'`). Typing the callback parameter as `boolean` can break type-checking and may mishandle the indeterminate state at runtime. Convert with `c === true` (or similar) before calling `handleColumnToggle` so the handler always receives a boolean.
```suggestion
                                            onCheckedChange={(c) => handleColumnToggle(f.value, c === true)}
```

`views={views.map(...)}` recreates the active view object on every parent render (via `{ ...v, ...viewDraft }`), even when `viewDraft` hasn't changed. `@object-ui/plugin-view`'s `ObjectView` effect depends on `activeView`, so this can trigger unnecessary data refetches / state resets. Consider memoizing the merged `views` array (and reusing the merged active view object) with `useMemo` keyed on `[views, activeViewId, viewDraft]` to keep references stable when nothing changed.
```suggestion
                            views={useMemo(
                                () =>
                                    views.map((v: any) =>
                                        v.id === activeViewId && viewDraft && viewDraft.id === v.id
                                            ? { ...v, ...viewDraft }
                                            : v
                                    ),
                                [views, activeViewId, viewDraft]
```
